question: Collingwood vs Carlton head to head over the last 10 years
note: A real chat_traces row from afl_dev (id 19), trimmed for display.
resolveEntities:
team_a: "Collingwood" -> Collingwood Magpies (id 4)
team_b: "Carlton" -> Carlton Blues (id 3)
season_from: 2016, season_to: 2026
tool: head_to_head({ team_a: "Collingwood", team_b: "Carlton", season_from: 2016, season_to: 2026, finals: "include" })
sql:
SELECT tm.season, COUNT(*) AS games,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tm.score > tm.opp_score) AS collingwood_wins,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tm.score < tm.opp_score) AS carlton_wins
FROM tm
WHERE tm.team_id = :a AND tm.opp_id = :b
GROUP BY tm.season ORDER BY tm.season
answer: Across the last 10 completed seasons, 2016-2025, Collingwood led Carlton 13 wins to 4, with no draws across 17 games.
